result:
T-DG7-DO-A2 is finished: both defects are fixed, `tool.node` has moved, T-A5 and T-A11 now pass, and all three acceptance checks exit 0. The one thing I couldn't run is the repository's own `clean-start-local.sh`, because it doesn't fit the disk. Nothing is committed. The handback is `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG7/T-DG7-DO-A2-devops-engineer.md` and the logs are in `T-DG7-DO-A2-evidence/` (15:42:44Z → 16:10:07Z).

**What changed**
- **P-1 (package names containing `_`):** the check now strips only pnpm's peer suffix after the version. `string_decoder@1.1.1` stays as it is, and `react-dom@19.1.0_react@19.1.0` becomes `react-dom@19.1.0`. The check moved out of `assemble-runtime.sh` into a new module, `deploy/scripts/check-virtual-store.mjs`, so it can be tested.
  - The new test file has 5 tests. All 5 pass on the new code. With the old expression swapped back in temporarily, 3 of 5 fail (exit 1); the file was restored and its sha256 checked.
  - I didn't use the fix DO-A proposed: it breaks scoped names that contain `_` and have a peer suffix (`@scope+under_score@2.0.0_…`). The test covers that case.
  - No other code in `deploy/**`, `tools/release/**`, `licenses/**` or `scripts/**` parses pnpm directory names this way.
- **P-2 (build paths left in the runtime tree):** `assemble-runtime.sh` now deletes `.modules.yaml`, `.pnpm-workspace-state-v1.json` and every `node_modules/.bin`, and its layout check asserts they are gone.
  - Nothing at runtime needs them. The image and the clean start run `node <file>` through `entrypoint.sh`, and the shipped code starts no child processes.
  - On the real tree, all 7 workspace packages still resolve and import after the removal. The tree contains no assembly path and no `/var/tmp`.
- **Q1:** `ARCHIVE-MANIFEST.json` `tool` now holds only `buildArchiveSha256`. `build-report.json` has `tool: {node, zlib, buildArchiveSha256}`, replacing its old top-level `node` and `zlib` keys. ADR-0062 §4.2 has a dated amendment saying so.

**Results**

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Offline build from the archive (`build-from-archive.sh`, no network) | PASS, 134.5 s. Archive sha256 `60a81b83…77e3`; 186 package directories, all in the shipped set |
| `tools/release` + `licenses` suite | 57 pass, 0 fail, 1 skip (bsdtar not installed) |
| T-A5 / T-A11 | ✔ / ✔ |
| `deploy/scripts` self-tests | 79/79 |
| `pnpm lint` / prettier / `validate.mjs --historical --stage DG6` | exit 0 / exit 0 / exit 0 |

**Not done or not proven**
- **Clean start:** the repository's `clean-start-local.sh` starts with a full `git clone` of about 3 GB, and the low point during the runs was 1.2 GB free. Instead I ran a derived copy of phase A that reuses the already built source and stripped runtime tree. It passed A1–A6 in 8.8 s. It does not replace the real script's clone, install, build and assemble steps, and phase B was not run.
- **Not run:** a Docker image build (no Docker daemon), the bsdtar half of T-A3, and live CI.
- **Long package names:** pnpm shortens very long directory names to a truncated name plus a hash. Such a name would fail the check loudly; none of the shipped packages has one today.
- **First pass superseded:** prettier failed on my two new files after the first full pass. I reformatted them and re-ran everything; the logs are from the second pass.
- None of this shows high-availability production readiness.

**For you to do**
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` is read-only to me. Run `cp deploy/ci/ci.yml .github/workflows/ci.yml`; that copy now also includes the new test.
- DO-J's seal step needs to read `tool.node` and `tool.zlib` from `build-report.json`.
- Closing P-1 and P-2 in `findings.json` is yours to do.

All my temporary trees are deleted and disk is back to 3.8 GB free.
